pattern: Death toll reported rising, never final
verdict: conditional on scale: 0/25 small (1-4 deaths), 17/21 mid (5-19), 5/7 mass (20+)
note: Rising tolls seen in 25/53 events; a clear final official figure was reported in 8. Big events 13/16 true vs small 9/37: most small events report a single stable toll (1-4 deaths). Original 7/7 holds for mass-casualty events, weakens as a general pattern. Several trues are weak (4->5 across different outlets).

verdict: conditional on scale and national declaration (28% small -> 52% mid -> 86% mass; 67% if nationally declared). Voiced mostly by officials (16/24) as "don't build near rivers"
note: mention_type: causal 24, location_only 13, none 16. Big events 10/16, small 14/37. Many small-event deaths are drivers or pedestrians swept off low-water bridges, where settlement framing is absent. Some trues come from non-news sources only (PMG for 2021-02, The Conversation for 2026-01, a July follow-up for 2026-05) or from floodplain framing without informal settlements (Ladysmith 2023). Original 7/7 'default' claim weakens substantially.

pattern: Presidential site visit as ritual story beat
verdict: conditional: mass-casualty or national-disaster events in provinces governed by the President's party - see pattern_conditions.md
note: President visit in 7/53 (big 5/16: 2019-04, 2022-04, 2024-06 EC, 2025-06 Mthatha, 2026-01; small 2/37: 2022-09 Jagersfontein, 2023-03 Port St Johns). No President visit found for several big events (e.g. 2023-12 Ladysmith, 2024-01, 2025-02 Lamontville, 2023-09 WC). Original 5/7 breaks as a general pattern; a President visit is a story beat only in the largest or most politically salient events.
Premier/Minister/MEC (mostly Premier or MEC) visits reported in 26/53: big 9/16, small 17/37. Coded separately from the President.

pattern: Officials quoted almost exclusively over residents
original_claim: 7 of 7 events; 1 academic causal quote in whole sample
verdict: holds at every scale (residents quoted in 48% small, 38% mid, 57% mass events); academic-quote claim breaks
note: Across all events 187 officials vs 58 residents quoted (32 others: NGOs, academics, church, business). 29/53 events had zero residents quoted; officials outnumbered residents in 47/53. The >=80% threshold is met in 35/53, several at exactly 0.8. Original 7/7 mostly holds in direction but weakens at the threshold. The original '1 academic causal quote in whole sample' breaks: 32 non-official, non-resident voices were quoted.

pattern: Climate change framing only after mass-casualty events
original_claim: 1 of 7 events (April 2022) explicitly; absent from smaller/frequent events
verdict: conditional on scale (12% small -> 33% mid -> 71% mass) and period (17% 2016-19, 13% 2020-22, 42% 2023-26); present in every weather-disaster presidential visit (6/6)
note: Explicit climate framing in 15/53: big 9/16 (56%) vs small 6/37 (16%). It appears in small events (2023-12 Dundee, 1 death; 2023-09 Cape coast, 2 deaths; 2025-02 eThekwini walls; 2023-06 eThekwini) and is often voiced by officials (Ramaphosa in Kariega 2024 and Durban 2019; KZN CoGTA via SAnews). Original 'only after mass-casualty events, 1 of 7' breaks in its strong form; the direction (more likely after big events) holds.
Some pre-event warning mentioned in 33/53 (big 11/16, small 22/37). Several trues are weak: warnings issued mid-event, for a different region, or general statements that warnings had been issued.
